en.description:
WristJoy - 53 Offline Games for Apple Watch

Turn your Apple Watch into a pocket arcade. WristJoy brings quick puzzle, arcade, board, card, sports and relaxing games to your wrist, made for short breaks and offline play.

Highlights:
• 53 games in one compact Watch-first collection.
• New: Last Stand, Drop Number, Snooker and Kitty Sudoku.
• No Wi-Fi required. Play anywhere, anytime.
• Smooth touch, Digital Crown controls and haptic feedback where they fit best.
• Game Center leaderboards for selected games, including the new games.

Game library
• Puzzle & Logic: Sudoku, Kitty Sudoku, 2048, Number Puzzle, Number Connect, Number Merge, One Stroke, Sokoban, Water Sort, Maze Escape, Minesweeper, Arrow Puzzle, Hexa Away
• Casual & Match: Mahjong, Fruit Pop, Star Pop, Link Link, Block Blast, Sand Blast, Tap Match, Bubble Shooter, Animal Merge, Drop Number
• Arcade & Action: Snake, Spherical Snake, Tetris, Breakout, Dino Run, Flight Rush, Ski Adventure, Sky Jump, Circle Jump, Bounce, Bridge Cross, Jump Jump, Tower Stack, Ball Run, Last Stand
• Board, Card & Sports: Tic Tac Toe, Gomoku, Reversi, Chinese Chess, Chess, Jungle Chess, Landlords, Billiards, Snooker, Spider Solitaire
• Relaxing Fun: Gold Miner, Electronic Wooden Fish

Great for commuting, waiting in line, taking a quick brain break, relaxing before bed, or playing when your phone stays in your pocket.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicyforwristjoy
Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/termsofserviceforwristjoy
Support: i@ztyuu.com
en.releaseNotes: Added 4 new Watch games: Last Stand, Drop Number, Snooker and Kitty Sudoku. Added Game Center leaderboards for the new games, refreshed game descriptions and improved the overall experience.

ja.description:
WristJoy - Apple Watch向け53種類のオフラインゲーム

Apple Watchを手首のミニゲーム機に。WristJoyには、パズル、アーケード、ボードゲーム、カード、スポーツ、リラックス系ゲームが入っています。

Highlights:
• Watchで遊びやすい53種類のゲームを収録。
• 新ゲーム: Last Stand、Drop Number、Snooker、Kitty Sudoku。
• Wi-Fiなしでオフラインプレイ可能。
• タッチ、Digital Crown、触覚フィードバックに最適化。
• 新ゲームを含む一部ゲームがGame Centerランキングに対応。

ゲーム一覧
• Puzzle & Logic: Sudoku, Kitty Sudoku, 2048, Number Puzzle, Number Connect, Number Merge, One Stroke, Sokoban, Water Sort, Maze Escape, Minesweeper, Arrow Puzzle, Hexa Away
• Casual & Match: Mahjong, Fruit Pop, Star Pop, Link Link, Block Blast, Sand Blast, Tap Match, Bubble Shooter, Animal Merge, Drop Number
• Arcade & Action: Snake, Spherical Snake, Tetris, Breakout, Dino Run, Flight Rush, Ski Adventure, Sky Jump, Circle Jump, Bounce, Bridge Cross, Jump Jump, Tower Stack, Ball Run, Last Stand
• Board, Card & Sports: Tic Tac Toe, Gomoku, Reversi, Chinese Chess, Chess, Jungle Chess, Landlords, Billiards, Snooker, Spider Solitaire
• Relaxing Fun: Gold Miner, Electronic Wooden Fish

通勤、待ち時間、短い休憩、就寝前のリラックスなど、スマホを取り出さずに少し遊びたい時にぴったりです。
